## Ranking

```{r fig.height = 7}
ccva_plot(fit, "ranking", n = 12)
```

```{r}
rk <- ccva_rank(fit, unc)
num <- vapply(rk, is.numeric, logical(1))
rk[num] <- lapply(rk[num], round, 3)
knitr::kable(utils::head(rk, 25), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r eval = length(x$outcomes) > 0 || !is.null(x$truth)}
knitr::kable(ccva_validate(fit), digits = 3,
             caption = "Validation against observed outcomes")
```

```{r eval = !is.null(unc), fig.height = 7}
unc

```
